description.value: 88 Supermarket is a Canadian-owned Asian grocery chain operating since 2008, with a recently opened Richmond location on Garden City Road. The store stocks an extensive range of Asian and western foods including daily fresh cuts of meat, live seafood, exotic produce, bakery, and dairy. A free membership club card with points rewards is available to shoppers.
